FAQ

Everything you need to know before applying.

What stage do you invest in?

We partner with founders at the earliest stages—from a clear idea to an early product with its first users.

How much do you invest?

We typically invest early checks to fund MVPs and initial traction.

Do you require traction?

A strong insight, a thoughtful team, and a clear understanding of the problem matter more than a polished pitch.

Where are you based?

This is an editable venture-studio concept. Replace this answer with your team’s location and how you work with founders.
